name: feasible_lp
title: Simple Feasible LP
description: Small, hand-verifiable feasible LP. Optimal is unique and easy to sanity-check: maximize 3x+2y s.t. x+y<=4, x+3y<=6, x,y>=0.

expected.note: Confirmed by independent reference solver (scipy/HiGHS); the vertex (3,1) is feasible but not optimal.
